local_patches.summary: Skip cells where getcell() returns NULL instead of writing through the null pointer. The row loop bounds against screen->state->rows while getcell() checks screen->rows, and the column loop is not bounded by screen->cols, so an erase rect derived from the state can outrun the screen buffer. Reachable by interleaving term_resize with term_pump; found by fuzz/run.sh term.

Stop writing continuation cells for a double-width glyph once getcell() returns NULL. A wide glyph placed on the final column has no room for its continuation cell, and the unconditional dereference of getcell()'s result was undefined behaviour that let the compiler elide the bounds checks and write one cell past the screen buffer. Deterministic Segmentation_Fault on linux_amd64; found by term.fuzz_vterm_ingest in Linux CI.

Do not emit two codepoints when only one slot remains. The ASCII branch writes the U+FFFD marker for an abandoned multi-byte sequence followed by the character itself, but the loop guard only proves room for one, so landing the pair on the last slot wrote one uint32 past the end of vt->tmpbuffer and corrupted the C heap. Reachable from any terminal output containing a truncated UTF-8 sequence; it made scripts/test.sh abort about 43% of the time.

components.name: Metal timestamp investigation retained binaries
components.build: Isolated diagnostic host/client builds using artifacts/timing-odin-control/odin and the source-built wgpu backend; not production dependencies or CI executables
limitations: Retention records identify surviving bytes, not exhaustive pre-build provenance or proof of capture-time immutability.

The v4 and v5 audits identify the compiler and build/game.dylib artifacts; the remaining v4 game libraries share the current surviving-byte checksum but are not independently identified by those audits.
These entries preserve investigation evidence only; they do not qualify timing correctness, capture health, or reproducibility.

components.name: Metal timestamp frozen game build trees v6-v11

limitations: prebuild-inputs.json in each tree records the sha256 of every copied compile input, including the copied accesskit libraries and fuzz binaries; those copies are retained only so the frozen tree matches its recorded identity and are never executed.
